newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee dips mildly on RBI's dlr purchases.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee dips mildly on RBI's dlr purchases.

text.p: The Indian rupee weakened mildly against the dollar in late morning trade on Wednesday after the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought dollars, dealers said.
The rupee opened Wednesday at 35.715/725 to the dollar.
"The RBI bought at 35.7250 to 35.7350 levels," a dealer with a foreign bank said.
The spot rupee was quoted at 35.727/737 after the central bank's intervention in the spot market, dealers said.
Forward premia opened up but appeared to be softening in the absence of RBI intervention, dealers said.
January dollars were quoted at 0.84/0.89 rupees in latest deals compared to the opening level of 0.84/0.86, they said.
